incidents.symptom: The stopped Gate-8 A40 Pod could not restart because its original host had no free GPU.
incidents.root_cause: Host-local A40 capacity was unavailable although secure-cloud A40 fleet capacity remained available.
incidents.repair: Provisioned an equivalent secure-cloud A40 Pod with the same image and 80 GB persistent workspace, restored the exact CORE_QWEN package profile, downloaded the exact pinned Qwen revision, verified the exact source checkout, reran remote preflight, and passed the frozen engineering gate before collection.

incidents.symptom: A TypeError escaped semantic-V3 canonicalization for one unhashable nested set literal and aborted before that generated row was journaled.
incidents.root_cause: The total deterministic raw-string fallback caught ValueError and SyntaxError from ast.literal_eval but omitted its TypeError failure mode.
incidents.repair: Condition-symmetric totality repair adds TypeError to the identical raw-string fallback; all preserved rows remain immutable and the one unjournaled key resumes under its identical frozen seed.
